title: Crunchbase Alternatives: 10 Tools Sorted by What You Actually Need (2026)
summary: Compare 10 Crunchbase alternatives by workflow: sales prospecting, deal sourcing, API integration, and budget options. Includes real pricing and feature breakdowns.
body_markdown: Chris writes about how modern teams use real-time data to make better decisions across sales, recruiting, and investment. His focus is on highlighting how live people and company insights help teams spot opportunities earlier, personalize outreach with context, and build stronger pipelines.
